About Figure

We’re Figure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Servicing Operations Specialist to join our growing team! As a Servicing Operations Specialist, you'll own the day-to-day servicing work that keeps our loans protected and moving, including insurance, property taxes, lien releases, and collateral file requests. You'll work with the Servicing Team, vendors, and cross-functional partners to close issues quickly and hit every deadline. If you want to own a large, varied workload and are ready to solve problems before they become deadlines, this role is for you.

  • Build the weekly insurance report and vendor boarding tapes

  • Monitor property taxes, run outreach, and make payments as needed
  • Handle CEMAs (NY State), lien release escalations, partial lien releases, and ADU subordination requests

  • Mentor the Servicing Team and serve as an escalation contact in your areas of expertise
  • Join regularly scheduled vendor management calls
  • Hold vendors accountable for meeting SLA’s and working with them to streamline processes
  • Lead or join cross-functional project teams as needed

What We Look For

  • Prior experience in mortgage loan servicing or origination, with working knowledge of industry terminology
  • Understanding of our internal Ops platform and external vendor platforms (Centerpoint, Digital Tax Portal, WebFTP, Simplifile, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office, especially Sheets and Excel
  • Switch quickly between insurance, taxes, partial releases, and other tasks throughout the day
  • Prioritize a large workload by importance and deadline
  • Make confident decisions and back them with supporting documentation
  • Manage your time well and stay organized
  • Solve problems and act with urgency
  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally
  • Experience with Salesforce (preferred)
  • Escrow or insurance experience (preferred)
  • Title review experience (preferred)
  • Vendor management experience (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

The Detection and Response Engineering (DaRE) team protects Chainalysis corporate assets and manages internal incident response. We reduce risk by building systems that detect and contain malicious activity while performing high-stakes digital forensics. Our mission is to ensure that as blockchain adoption grows, our own infrastructure remains resilient against evolving threats.

Role Description:

We are seeking a hands-on security engineer to own the operation, and continuous improvement of Zscaler across Chainalysis.

This role is responsible for Zscaler configuration, integration, policy development, tuning, troubleshooting, impacted engineering and bulk data collection/analysis, and system maintenance. Working with the engineering teams who administer Google Workspace, AWS, and generative AI technology, you will ensure Zscaler controls protect enterprise and network access, along with sensitive information while supporting global business operations.

You will also help develop our insider risk controls, leveraging Zscaler and Splunk-based detections to identify, investigate, and respond to potential data loss, unauthorized access, and misuse of company information. You will be part of the Security team, working closely with the Detections and Response Team along with the Business Technology team.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Significant hands-on security engineering experience in a cloud-based technology or SaaS environment.

  • Deep experience implementing and operating Zscaler, including DLP, policy tuning, integrations, maintenance, and complex troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating Zscaler into environments using Google Workspace and AWS, with a strong understanding of their data-sharing and application access workflows.

  • Hands-on Splunk detection engineering and investigation experience, including proficiency in SPL, correlation searches, alerts, and dashboards.

  • Experience developing insider risk or data protection controls and correlating activity across multiple security log sources.

  • Strong understanding of networking, DNS, proxies, TLS inspection, identity, authentication, and endpoint security.

  • Scripting and automation skills, sound judgment with sensitive information, and clear communication across technical and business teams.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own Zscaler ongoing operations.

  • Integrate and maintain Zscaler controls across Google Workspace, AWS-hosted resources, identity services, endpoints, and enterprise applications.

  • Develop and tune access policies, data classifications, DLP rules, enforcement actions, and exceptions to improve protection and reduce false positives.

  • Troubleshoot connectivity, authentication, inspection, application compatibility, and performance issues; manage upgrades and configuration changes through documented testing and validation.

  • Develop, test, and tune insider risk detections in Splunk using Zscaler logs and relevant Google Workspace, AWS, identity, and endpoint telemetry.

  • Write and maintain SPL queries, correlation searches, alerts, and dashboards; validate log quality and coverage with platform owners.

  • Translate insider risk scenarios into detection and response workflows addressing unauthorized sharing, unusual downloads, bulk data movement, and potential exfiltration.

  • Support investigations and incident response, partnering with Security, IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and HR under approved monitoring and evidence-handling practices.

  • Automate operational tasks and maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and metrics demonstrating control effectiveness and detection quality.

Nice to have experience:

  • Relevant Zscaler certifications

  • Experience protecting source code, intellectual property, and customer information.

  • Familiarity with financial services customer requirements, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About Flowdesk

At Flowdesk, we are building the infrastructure powering the next era of global finance. As a full-service digital asset trading and technology firm, we provide liquidity solutions, OTC trading, and market infrastructure that connect digital assets to global markets with institutional-grade precision, transparency, and scale. Flowdesk combines expertise from traditional finance, algorithmic trading, and blockchain technology to deliver always-on trading capabilities across the digital asset ecosystem.

Founded in 2020, we have grown into a global team supporting institutions, exchanges, and token issuers worldwide as the financial system evolves toward tokenized markets.

Why join Flowdesk? You’ll be joining a company operating at the intersection of finance, technology, and crypto. solving complex market problems, building critical infrastructure, and helping shape how digital assets move globally. We move fast, think long term, and work with a strong ownership mindset across engineering, trading, product, operations, and business teams.

Role Description

Flowdesk is a cloud-native crypto market-making firm building security-first infrastructure. We operate across several regulated jurisdictions, including the EU (MiCA, DORA), Dubai (VARA), Singapore (MAS) and the US, and we hold ourselves to SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

As our Security GRC Lead, you’ll own our IT security risk and third-party risk management (TPRM) programmes. We want GRC that runs on code, not spreadsheets: you’ll automate evidence collection, control monitoring, vendor assessments and risk reporting so that compliance holds up continuously, not just at audit time.

This is an individual contributor role focused fully on GRC, reporting directly to the Group CISO. When incidents or escalations come up, you’ll also support the wider security team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the IT security risk programme: maintain the risk register, run assessments, track treatment plans and report risk posture to senior management.
  • Own the TPRM programme: vendor due diligence and onboarding, risk tiering, periodic reviews, offboarding, and the DORA register of information.
  • Design and build automation across GRC: continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, vendor risk workflows and live risk dashboards.
  • Map controls once and reuse them across SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA, MiCA, VARA, MAS and US requirements, so the same evidence meets several obligations.
  • Run day-to-day IT and security compliance activities, including access reviews, policy attestations, security awareness training and tracking remediation of audit findings.
  • Lead security’s side of external audits and regulator requests, coordinating evidence across Security, IT and Engineering.
  • Test controls directly in our cloud and SaaS environment rather than relying only on attestations, and keep security policies and standards aligned with how we actually operate.
  • Support the wider security team during incidents and escalations.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 5+ years in information security, with at least 2 years in GRC, risk or compliance.
  • A technical grounding in IT or cloud environments. enough to understand how controls work in practice and test them yourself.
  • Strong automation skills: scripting in Python or similar, working with APIs, and building integrations between GRC, cloud and SaaS platforms.
  • Experience in regulated financial services or crypto, with exposure to at least one of MiCA, DORA, VARA, MAS or US financial regulation (e.g. SEC, FINRA), plus working knowledge of DORA. particularly ICT risk management and ICT third-party risk.
  • Experience preparing for and running SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.
  • Has built or run an IT security risk programme (identification, assessment, treatment and reporting) or a TPRM programme (due diligence, risk tiering, contractual security requirements and ongoing monitoring), with exposure to the other.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
  • AWS or GCP security experience.
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta or Drata.
  • Policy-as-code or infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, OPA).

Location

  • London

Person Profile

  • An engineer’s mindset applied to GRC: you’d rather automate a control check than chase a spreadsheet.
  • Hands-on and evidence-driven. you verify controls yourself instead of taking attestations at face value.
  • A clear writer and communicator who can explain risk to engineers and senior management alike.
  • Autonomous: you run projects end-to-end, keeping senior management informed and involved where needed.
  • Pragmatic about compliance. you want policies that reflect how the business actually operates.

Company Culture & Values

  • Take Action & Own the Mission
  • Be of Service & Contribute
  • Innovate, Create Value, & Be Courageous
  • Act with Integrity & Respect

Benefits

  • International environment (English is the main language)
  • 100% health coverage
  • Team events and offsites
  • Company Pension scheme
  • Learning and Development budget

Recruitment Process

Our process is designed to assess genuine technical and GRC depth. Candidates should expect the following stages:

  • Stage 1: Initial background screening with TA (30 mins)
  • Stage 2: Hiring Manager Screen with the Group CISO (45 mins): Experience, motivations and an overview of your GRC and risk background.
  • Stage 3: GRC Technical Deep Dive (45–60 mins): Discussion of control design and testing, framework mapping (SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA) and a practical risk or third-party risk scenario.
  • Stage 4: AI-enabled, time-limited, domain-relevant at-home exercise to be submitted (e.g. automating evidence collection or designing a vendor risk-tiering approach).
  • Stage 5: Onsite Interview: In-person presentation of your exercise and discussion with stakeholders from Security, IT and Engineering.
  • Stage 6: Head of TA/Talent Strategy Round-Up Interview

About Bitdeer:

We are seeking

We are seeking a Senior Director, Interconnection & Network Economics to own the architecture and economics of how Bitdeer’s AI cloud connects to the rest of the world. You will decide what our border, interconnection and long-haul connectivity should be and what it should cost, from peering and Internet Exchange (IX) strategy and hyperscaler on-ramps to build-versus-lease decisions for data center interconnect (DCI). You will turn GPU-cluster performance requirements into a north-south network design and a delivered cost curve. You will work alongside our Network Infrastructure & Connectivity team, which sources, contracts and operates that connectivity, and set the target architecture and cost model they deliver against. This role suits a recognized interconnection practitioner who has run edge connectivity and optical transport for production GPU infrastructure.

What you will be responsible for

  • Own Bitdeer’s traffic-exchange architecture and its delivered cost curve ($/Mbps, $/Gbps), and set the target interconnection architecture and cost model for our AI cloud and data center sites.
  • Define and lead peering and IX strategy, including Bitdeer’s public and private interconnection posture and IX participation, and represent Bitdeer in the peering and IX community.
  • Set meet-me room (MMR) and border physical design standards, including separated MDFs, distinct power and cooling failure domains, and dual-homed cluster border switches.
  • Design hyperscaler interconnect, including AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute and Google Cloud Interconnect, and agree in advance the burst profiles both sides must support.
  • Lead build-versus-lease architecture and costing for DCI, metro transport and dark fiber, and recommend the position for leadership approval before it is sourced and delivered.
  • Model GPU-cluster SLA exposure at the border, including path-length asymmetry, ECMP hashing, jitter and cluster dropout, and turn it into design requirements and SLA-credit risk.
  • Define Bitdeer’s InfiniBand and RoCE posture at the north-south boundary so that border design supports GPU backend fabrics and their migration path.
  • Contribute production InfiniBand and RoCEv2 experience to GPU cluster fabric design reviews (fat-tree, rail-optimized and dragonfly topologies), so that east-west fabric choices and the north-south border are designed together.

  • Advise on connectivity and GPU fabric incidents that have an architectural or cross-boundary root cause, and feed the lessons back into design standards and the cost model.

  • Production accountability for edge connectivity and/or backbone optical transport supporting large-scale GPU or AI infrastructure across multiple data centers.
  • Hands-on production experience with InfiniBand and RoCEv2 GPU fabrics (fat-tree, rail-optimized or dragonfly topologies; Nvidia, Arista and Cisco platforms), including RoCE migration planning, and familiarity with UFM, adaptive routing, DCQCN/ECN congestion control and NCCL tuning.

  • Strong DCI and long-haul design skills: 400G-class DCI, DWDM and optical transport, build-versus-lease costing, optical lead times and in-line amplifier (ILA) site support.
  • WAN-scale routing expertise in eBGP/iBGP, MPLS/RSVP-TE and EVPN-VXLAN, with an informed position on SRv6.
  • Ability to connect network behavior to business outcomes, such as tracing jitter through ECMP hashing to GPU job dropout and SLA-credit exposure.
  • Experience designing hyperscaler interconnect (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect) with cloud partners.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to make the architecture and build-versus-lease case to senior leadership and to work closely with procurement and operations teams.

Finance is moving onchain. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, securities and funds are changing how money and assets are issued, held and transferred. Today, we secure hundreds of billions of dollars in assets every month for more than 500 clients worldwide.

Our platform processes transactions for banks and fintechs around the clock and it has run at 99.997% uptime since 2022 with zero breaches. That record is the product.   • Configure and operate the AWS Nitro Enclaves and secure workloads that protect key material and signing.

  • Keep Node.js services and the databases behind them fast and reliable under real financial workloads.

  • Document what you build and carry the infrastructure controls through SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

  • A record of designing and operating production infrastructure on AWS for systems where downtime or a breach has real consequences.
